data.professional_title: BUSINESS ANALYST | PAYMENTS | PAYMENT LIFECYCLE | TRANSACTION PROCESSING | BANKING
data.summary:
Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience in banking and financial services, specializing in digital payments, transaction processing, business analysis, and system integration.
Experienced in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM), AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, and translating business needs into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
Strong understanding of the end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, authentication, authorization, processing, settlement, reconciliation, refunds, reversals, and exception handling across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, card, and cross-border payment ecosystems.
Skilled in API analysis, core banking systems, payment gateways, UAT, defect management, and Agile delivery.

responsibilities: Analyzing requirements and business processes across payment operations and end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, authentication, authorization, validation, routing, transaction processing, payment status tracking (successful/failed/pending), reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exceptions, reconciliation, and settlement across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).

Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) definition and payment operating model enhancements by evaluating current-state processes, designing future-state workflows, aligning business capabilities, operating procedures, and system interactions to support scalable payment operations and digital transformation initiatives.

Conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, identifying process gaps, and documenting BRDs, Functional Requirements, business rules, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and API requirements for payment-related enhancements involving payment gateways, payment processors, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), merchant systems, and payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, and SWIFT).

Collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders to clarify requirements, analyse system integrations, API dependencies, data flows, payment interfaces, notification services, fraud/AML checks, reconciliation and settlement systems, support SIT/UAT, validate payment scenarios, and manage defects through successful delivery.

Analyzed end-to-end payment workflows covering payment initiation, authentication, authorization, validation, routing, processing, successful/failed/pending transactions, reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exception handling, reconciliation, settlement, and payment lifecycle across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives through current-state assessment, future-state process design, and payment process standardization.

Translated business requirements into BRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business rules while collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders for domestic and international payment solutions.

Analyzed system interactions and data flows across digital channels, payment gateways, payment processors, merchant systems, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT), notification services, AML/fraud monitoring, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting platforms; supported SIT/UAT, defect management, API validation, payment message validation (ISO 8583/ISO 20022), and production issue analysis.
Gathered and analysed requirements for CRM portal enhancements supporting customer information management and banking workflows.
Performed process analysis, identified functional gaps, defined business rules and workflow requirements, and prepared functional requirements for technology teams.
Created use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios; supported defect triage and business validation across the SDLC.
Worked on enhancement and relaunch initiatives for an AI-powered ChatBanking platform supporting digital customer service and banking journeys.
Gathered and analysed requirements for chatbot-led customer journeys, service requests, transaction-related queries, authentication, validations, and customer-care escalation.
Created AS-IS/TO-BE process flows, use cases, functional requirements, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios.

Analyzed interactions between customers, chatbot services, CRM, customer-care teams, core banking systems, authentication services, and dependent systems; supported UAT, defect triage, and release readiness.

Managed end to end banking relationships across retail banking products and services, gaining hands on understanding of customer journeys, account servicing, digital banking, transaction processing and banking operations.

Worked closely with customers and internal banking teams to resolve service request, understand business requirements and navigate banking processes, building strong domain expertise that later supported the transition into Business Analysis.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE DBS BANK | Business Analyst | Apr 2026 – Present Project: Payments Operations & Processing Transformation • Analyzing requirements and business processes across payment operations and end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation,
authentication, authorization, validation, routing, transaction processing, payment status tracking (successful/failed/pending), reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exceptions, reconciliation, and settlement across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) definition and payment operating model enhancements by evaluating current-state processes, designing future-state workflows, aligning business capabilities, operating procedures, and system interactions to support scalable payment operations and digital transformation initiatives.
Conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, identifying process gaps, and documenting BRDs, Functional Requirements, business rules, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and API requirements for payment-related enhancements involving payment gateways, payment processors, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), merchant systems, and payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, and SWIFT).
Collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders to clarify requirements, analyse system integrations, API dependencies, data flows, payment interfaces, notification services, fraud/AML checks, reconciliation and settlement systems, support SIT/UAT, validate payment scenarios, and manage defects through successful delivery.
AXIS BANK | Business Analyst | Aug 2024 – Mar 2026 Project: Digital Payments & Transaction Processing Enhancement • Analyzed end-to-end payment workflows covering payment initiation, authentication, authorization, validation, routing, processing,
successful/failed/pending transactions, reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exception handling, reconciliation, settlement, and payment lifecycle across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives through current-state assessment, future-state process design, and payment process standardization. • Translated business requirements into BRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business rules while collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders for domestic and international payment solutions.
Analyzed system interactions and data flows across digital channels, payment gateways, payment processors, merchant systems, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT), notification services, AML/fraud monitoring, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting platforms; supported SIT/UAT, defect management, API validation, payment message validation (ISO 8583/ISO 20022), and production issue analysis.
INDUSIND BANK | Business Analyst | Jun 2023 – Jul 2024 Project: CRM Portal Enhancement • Gathered and analysed requirements for CRM portal enhancements supporting customer information management and banking workflows. • Performed process analysis, identified functional gaps, defined business rules and workflow requirements, and prepared functional requirements for
technology teams.
Created use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios; supported defect triage and business validation across the SDLC.
HDFC BANK | Business Analyst | Jun 2021 – Mar 2023 Project: HDFC ChatBanking Enhancement | Business Analyst: Mar 2021 – Mar 2023 • Worked on enhancement and relaunch initiatives for an AI-powered ChatBanking platform supporting digital customer service and banking journeys. • Gathered and analysed requirements for chatbot-led customer journeys, service requests, transaction-related queries, authentication, validations, and
customer-care escalation.
Created AS-IS/TO-BE process flows, use cases, functional requirements, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios. • Analyzed interactions between customers, chatbot services, CRM, customer-care teams, core banking systems, authentication services, and dependent systems; supported UAT, defect triage, and release readiness.
Relationship Manager | May 2019 – Jun 2021 • Managed end to end banking relationships across retail banking products and services, gaining hands on understanding of customer journeys,
account servicing, digital banking, transaction processing and banking operations.
Worked closely with customers and internal banking teams to resolve service request, understand business requirements and navigate banking processes, building strong domain expertise that later supported the transition into Business Analysis.
